known_secrets.text: After the Agnikanda, certain storage records were altered.
I noticed discrepancies between recorded harvests and actual stored amounts.
Some records appear rewritten rather than lost.
I suspect someone inside the administrative chain changed them.
There are storage tunnels beneath the older terrace foundations.
They are not part of the current settlement's design.
I have used one of them for hidden reserves.
I do not fully trust the shrine's blessing rituals on food.
But I allow them because conflict would be worse than uncertainty.
